name: Planted Hardware
description: Hardware implants left in place after the initial access phase provide ongoing access capability without requiring re-entry. The LAN Turtle provides persistent network access, the Wi-Fi Pineapple maintains a wireless foothold, and the ESPKey continues harvesting credentials indefinitely. The operational lifetime of planted hardware depends on power source, network connectivity, and the target's security sweep schedule. All planted hardware must be recovered per engagement rules of engagement.

blue.det: Physical device discovery during security sweep; network anomaly from implant; WIDS detection; unusual RF emissions.
blue.cm: Regular physical security sweeps including ceiling spaces; TSCM for high-security areas; NAC preventing implant network access; WIDS for wireless implants; audit all network ports.
